title: The Tao of OMIS
narrativeSpine: Three spirals examine love, difference and return through embodied lovers and higher observers, distinguishing revisable influence from ontological capture.
firstSceneDraft: The Tao of OMIS explores love without treating another person as a completed answer.
Its standalone speculative triptych begins with finite people in a habitable dusk belt.
Their attraction opens a question about influence, difference, and a future left unclaimed.
The larger realms preserve that intimate question while changing its scale.
visualActionProposal: Two rescue-boat currents meet through memory reeds; their channels support each other without merging into one controlled course.
